assessments.reasoning: The six verified publisher ranges establish the covered material, distinguish the preferred form for modification from executable forms, and connect section 3.2(a) to the source-distribution duties in section 3.1. Both the trigger and the access conditions appear in the governing text.

limitations: The requirement reaches the Covered Software. The text supplies neither a fixed deadline nor a fixed monetary ceiling.
Section 4 qualifies the distribution duties if compliance is legally impossible, as described in the shared scope below.
reasoning: Section 3.2(a) imposes two duties when Covered Software is distributed in Executable Form. The distributor must make the covered source available under section 3.1 and tell executable recipients how to obtain it. The means must be reasonable, access timely, and the charge within the cost of distribution to the recipient.
